note: Upland oak-hickory forest above Apple Creek near New Wells, with a shooting range, trails and two primitive camping areas: one by small ponds off the western gravel road (this pin) and one at a gravel pull-in off the northeastern road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC-designated camping ('Designated Camping Sites', 'Individual Campsites'; 2026 map shows two camping sites), free, FCFS, no hookups. The two areas are 4.3 km apart with separate roads - split candidate. Pin on the western camping point. Not waterfront confirmed (ponds ~1 acre).
flags: SPLIT CANDIDATE: the 2026 area map and MDC GIS show two camping areas 4.3 km apart: west 37.54401,-89.58164 (this pin; lot 37.54406,-89.58038 on the gravel road in from the CR 525 side) and northeast 37.56328,-89.54154 (a gravel pull-in with a short loop on the eastern gravel road off Route CC toward CR 456; lot 37.56641,-89.54344). Separate roads, both drive-in on gravel.

INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Designated Camping Sites' and 'Individual Campsites'. West area: the GIS camping point is in open woods ~110 m west of the gravel lot, beside a dirt track and mowed strip along a small pond's dam; whether rigs camp on the lot or drive the dirt track is not shown - the lot (gravel, on a maintained gravel road) is reachable by a 23-ft rig. Northeast area: a clear gravel camping pull-in right off the gravel road. No ford or posted limit on either road.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. The west site's ponds are ~0.5 ha (~1.3 acres) and ~0.15 ha - ponds under 5 acres, no value. Apple Creek is ~1.5 km north.
Pin 37.54401,-89.58164 is the MDC camping point, ~110 m from the lot - fine.
